t: This is 2 Palace Green, a nineteenth-century house in Kensington. It was commissioned by the novelist William Makepeace Thackeray, an English writer and illustrator best known for Vanity Fair, his satirical portrait of British society from 1847 and 1848. He also wrote The Luck of Barry Lyndon. So this house is one he had built, which makes it a place tied directly to his own choices, rather than somewhere he simply visited.
